worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.summary: Boils water and blasts a widening fan of scalding steam: foes inside take special damage, are shoved and soaked, and their freeze is thawed. Under harsh sunlight the blast is hotter and is not weakened.
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.use.0: Land a boosted water hit under harsh sunlight
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.use.1: Cover a row of foes in front of you at once
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.use.2: Thaw the freeze on a target
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.use.3: Leave scalding wetness on your enemies
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.description: Deals about %1$s special damage to each enemy in the fan; under harsh sunlight that segment is x1.5.
The steam reaches %1$s blocks over a %2$s degree fan, covers at most 4 enemies, and shoves anyone hit away from the caster.
A target hit is soaked for about %1$s and pushed about %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.rule.thaw: The hit thaws the target's freeze, and the caster's own freeze is thawed as the water boils.
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.bellow.on: Bellow mode: fan x1.35 and soak x1.3, but power x0.9, range x0.9, +2 ticks windup and +6 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.bellow.off: Jet mode: narrower, hotter and faster, good for singling one target out.
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s windup it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.growth.0: From level %1$s the steam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hydrosteam.growth.1: From level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the fan widens.
On (bellow): fan x1.35 and soak x1.3 to catch more foes, but power x0.9, range x0.9, +2 ticks windup and +6 ticks cooldown. Off (jet, default): narrower, hotter and faster, good for singling one target out.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values blast from farther away.
On: rank frozen targets last, because the steam thaws them (it helps them); off: ignore freeze and rank it as an ordinary ranged attack.
